text: What would you say, if they threw you into a fire? He said: Allah is enough for us.
They threw him into a blazing furnace. His crime? He had said: your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth.
But Allah said: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."
Who was this man, who stood alone against his father, his people, and a king?
The man Allah Himself took as a friend. The one in whose descendants Allah placed prophethood. The one who raised the foundations of the Kaaba.
This is the complete story of Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, from the Quran and the authentic Sunnah.
